name: Speech/Music Marker
author: Navidrome
description: Detects spoken intro/outro segments around a track's musical content using host inaSpeechSegmenter classification (after Demucs vocal isolation) and reports skip/intro_speech and skip/outro_speech media markers

library.reason: To read the track's file path for speech/music analysis

speechmusicdetect.reason: To run host inaSpeechSegmenter classification against the track's audio
